validation.oracle: Independent time-layer DP, unit-cost Dijkstra equivalent; quadratic-root collision

scope.model: 2D position + integer time, 1m/1s axial moves or wait. Robot and obstacle disc radius .2m; contact is collision.
scope.prediction: Given piecewise-linear tracks, held after last endpoint.
scope.goal: Hold at goal until finite horizon, each segment checked.
scope.limits: Earliest arrival on this finite time-expanded graph only. No dynamics, learned prediction, uncertainty, hard realtime, multi-agent negotiation or real robot.
